bug.title: --freeze-reference cannot add the evaluation canary to a deployment that already froze the toy pair
bug.symptoms: On a store holding an active toy reference pair and no canary_evaluation_reference row, `python -m canary.run --freeze-reference` with NULLIUS_CANARY_CAMPAIGN_ID and NULLIUS_CANARY_NODE_ID set exits 1 with canary_reference_exists and freezes nothing, even when both evaluators are supplied. The evaluation canary can therefore never be frozen on such a deployment, and every later run records evaluation_canary=0.
bug.reproduction_steps: In a tmp sqlite store, call main(["--freeze-reference"]) with no evaluation env (freezes the toy pair). Then call main(["--freeze-reference"]) with both evaluation env vars set and stub evaluate_node/replay_policy returning finite floats. It returns 1 with canary_reference_exists and no canary_evaluation_reference row exists.
bug.expected: - --freeze-reference with the evaluation canary configured (both env vars set and both evaluators supplied), an active toy pair already on record, and no evaluation reference yet: freezes only the evaluation canary, leaves the toy pair untouched, prints the existing toy reference_id and exits 0. - Unchanged refusals: toy pair on record and evaluation not configured is still canary_reference_exists; an evaluation reference already on record is still canary_evaluation_reference_exists; configured without evaluators is still refused before anything is written. A fresh store freezes both, as today. - A freeze refuses, writing nothing, when either evaluator returns a non-finite value (a policy that commits nothing replays to -inf, and |(-inf) - (-inf)| is NaN, which would record a break every night). The refusal has its own code word, canary_evaluation_score_not_finite, and names which half (node or replay) and the value. - main() gains a keyword seam evaluation_config_sha256 (Optional[str]). The freeze stores it on the evaluation reference row (new nullable column config_sha256 in that table's CREATE; for an existing table, probe the columns and ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN). A plain run that has a frozen evaluation reference refuses, before writing a run row, with its own code word canary_evaluation_config_mismatch when the seam's value differs from the stored one (including None against a stored value). A stored NULL accepts any value, so a reference frozen before this change keeps working. - Tests in test_canary_run.py for every bullet above, using stub evaluators only. The canary member suite passes.
bug.actual: Root cause: _freeze_reference checks for an active toy pair first and raises canary_reference_exists unconditionally, so the evaluation freeze branch is reachable only on a store with no toy pair. Freeze also accepts any float, including -inf, and records no evaluation config identity.
bug.constraints: Only the two listed files change Do not change the toy pair's freeze, replay or run-row shape, or any exit code Do not edit docs/preregistration/ or docs/user-journeys/

bug.title: ./run.sh canary never supplies the real evaluators, so no canary run can include the evaluation canary and dreaming is refused forever
bug.symptoms: `./run.sh canary` prints evaluation_canary=false on every run; `./run.sh dream` is refused for a stale or missing evaluation-canary pass; setting NULLIUS_CANARY_CAMPAIGN_ID and NULLIUS_CANARY_NODE_ID makes --freeze-reference refuse with "no evaluator was supplied to freeze it".
bug.reproduction_steps: On a fresh tmp store with NULLIUS_CANARY_CAMPAIGN_ID=x and NULLIUS_CANARY_NODE_ID=y set, run `python -m canary.run --freeze-reference`. It exits 1 naming the missing evaluator. No entry point anywhere in the workspace passes evaluate_node or replay_policy to canary.run.main.
bug.expected: - New module orchestrator/canary_cli.py, run as `python -m orchestrator.canary_cli [--freeze-reference]`. It calls canary.run.main with the same argv and env, plus, when orchestrator._context.load_evaluation_context(env) returns a context with non-empty oos_dates: - evaluate_node(campaign_id, node_id): that node's out-of-sample cost-adjusted IR through orchestrator._financial_eval._oos_ir, using a NEW FinancialEvalContext for every call, so the per-run cache can never answer a nightly re-evaluation from memory. - replay_policy(campaign_id): the score of score_on_financial_world over deploy/dreaming/incumbent.m2.py's source (the M3 baseline) and that campaign, also with a new FinancialEvalContext per call. - evaluation_config_sha256: the sha256 of the file NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG names (reuse the existing helper dream.py stamps rows with; do not re-implement it). With no evaluation config, or one with no oos_dates, it passes no evaluators, so canary.run's own refusals and toy-only behaviour apply unchanged. Exit codes are canary.run.main's. - run.sh: the canary verb runs orchestrator.canary_cli instead of canary.run; nothing else in run.sh changes. - deploy/systemd/nullius-canary.service gains Environment=NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG=%h/.config/nullius/campaign/evaluation-config-archive-perp-bn.json and Environment=NULLIUS_COST_MODEL_PATH=%h/projects/nullius/packages/cost-model/src/cost_model/binance_usdm.yaml (the same cost-model line nullius-shadow.service carries), each with a one-line comment saying why. The schedule and OnFailure are unchanged. - CLAUDE.md's operator-verb table row for canary names python -m orchestrator.canary_cli and says it needs NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG for the evaluation canary; change nothing else in CLAUDE.md. - test_canary_cli.py: with a stub evaluation context (monkeypatched loader and scorers, no sandbox, no snapshot), main wires both evaluators and the config sha into canary.run.main, each evaluator call gets a distinct FinancialEvalContext, and the replay scores incumbent.m2.py's source; with NULLIUS_EVALUATION_CONFIG unset no evaluator is passed. The orchestrator tests touched pass.
bug.actual: Root cause: feature 5 (274b72f) added the evaluator seams to canary.run.main but no caller was ever written; the canary member cannot import orchestrator, so the wiring has to live in orchestrator, and run.sh still points at the bare canary.run module.
bug.constraints: Only the listed files change, plus the two new files Do not edit packages/orchestrator/src/orchestrator/_sandbox_child.py, packages/contract/**, src/app/** (baked into the gVisor runtime root) Do not edit docs/preregistration/, docs/user-journeys/, deploy/shadow/, packages/router/ or the shadow modules Do not install or enable any systemd unit
